# Romantic paper keepsakes, V51

Original image_gen artwork directed by the owner's supplied romantic scrapbook reference for his girlfriend. The reference's “my boy” label is adapted to “my girl”. Plush penguins, lipstick kisses, a rose foil heart and blush/berry balloons keep the pink-primary book, with a small midnight-blue accent from the reference. These are generated decorative objects, not personal-event photographs.

## Source and delivery

- PNG: `exec-9baee92e-3593-4a9a-ab58-cc811ed80789.png`, 1536 × 1024 RGBA.
- Delivery: `romance-keepsakes.webp`, 1536 × 1024 RGBA, 586,992 bytes.
- WebP SHA256: `5cfad76424598466aff911516dfcd17e64ffe4c84b9027168004327f5e6fed76`.
- Quality 94/method 6/exact WebP preserves every original alpha byte and full dimensions. No source crop, resize, recoloring or manual transparency cleanup is applied.
- RGB color visible beneath alpha-zero pixels in a raw viewer is transparent on the actual paper. The image is not presented with that raw background.
- Eight measured frames are defined in `fandom-stickers.js`. Two separating polygons keep the penguin pair and adjacent red kiss independent. Pixel analysis retains all main subject components above alpha 24 and excludes every neighboring subject component at that threshold. The source image is unchanged.

## Arrangement

Seven placed pieces use seven motifs: penguin pair, red kiss, blue kiss, “my girl”, kiss-heart cluster, foil heart and balloon bouquet. The reference-directed kraft quote remains available on the source sheet but is not placed as a tiny unreadable note. It does not replace the owner's personal writing.

Seven previous minor ornament placements are retired from rendering while their source records remain available. The full earlier 68-entry collection is retained; the source collection now has 75 entries. The default arrangement remains 50 interior pieces and one attached cover piece, including all 13 named portrait/crest instances and all 15 birthday-25 pieces. The main cover collage is unchanged.

Native and Three use the same complete frames, uniform proportions and physical-paper attachment pipeline. Pieces remain decorative, without captions, new pointer targets or idle loops. Existing page turns, folded notes, birthday candle, gift and five personal cats keep their own sources and behavior.
